entity.label: Legal entity
entity.configured: Legal entities are configured by administration.

provisional.title: Provisional screen (partial)
provisional.chart: Accounts are added by a draft that someone else approves. The chart is illustrative and waits for the developer foundation (E.0) and an accounting adviser (E-16).
provisional.account: Balances come from posted journals only. The workspace waits for the developer foundation (E.0) before it is complete.
provisional.journals: Journals are prepared by one person and approved and posted by someone else. The list waits for the developer foundation (E.0) before it is complete.
provisional.create: Only manual journals exist in this wave. Cash at bank and revenue accounts are locked until their decisions are taken (E-17, E-15).
provisional.reverse: A posted journal is never edited: it is corrected by a reversal that someone else approves and posts.
provisional.reports: Computed from the same posted journals. Revenue recognition is not set (E-15), so profit is a management view.
provisional.periods: One period record per legal entity and month. At integration it is shared with the cashbook.
provisional.rules: Posting rules are proposals. Nothing is posted from them until an accounting adviser decides E-15, E-16 and E-17.
provisional.bank: Sample statements only. Imported lines are unmatched statement lines: never receipts, never settled.
provisional.fictional: Prototype with fictional money. No bank, payment or transfer is connected.

lock.cash_evidenceHint: Cash at bank changes only from confirmed payments or settlement confirmations (E-17). None exist in this wave, so no manual journal may touch it.
lock.revenue_policyHint: No revenue is recognised until the revenue recognition policy is decided (E-15).

chart.title: Chart of accounts
chart.intro: The accounts of one legal entity, with balances from posted journals only.
chart.draftEffect: The account is added to the chart only when someone else approves it. Accounts are never deleted once used.
chart.drafted: Account {{code}} drafted. It waits for approval by someone else.
chart.codeHint: Four digits; the first is 1 assets, 2 liabilities, 3 equity, 4 income, 5 expenses.
chart.name: Name
chart.approved: Account {{code}} approved and added to the chart.
chart.rejectEffect: The draft is kept as rejected; the chart does not change.
chart.ownDraft: You drafted this account: someone else approves it.

account.title: Account workspace
account.choose: Choose an account from the chart
account.unmatched_one: {{count}} unmatched statement line on this bank account (in {{credits}}, out {{debits}}). It changes no balance.
account.unmatched_other: {{count}} unmatched statement lines on this bank account (in {{credits}}, out {{debits}}). They change no balance.
account.bankNote: Statement lines are not receipts: the balance moves only with posted journals.
account.noPending: No journal waiting on this account.
account.pendingNote: Draft, submitted and approved journals are not in the balance until they are posted.

journals.title: Journal entries
journals.intro: Every journal of the legal entity, by state. A journal changes balances only when it is posted.
journals.search: Search by reference, description or person

journal.title: Journal {{ref}}
journal.acknowledge: I checked the lines, the accounts and the date.
journal.nothingForYou: Nothing for you to do on this journal.
journal.immutable: A posted journal is never changed. A mistake is corrected by a reversal journal, approved and posted by someone else.

effect.approve: The journal becomes approved. It changes no balance until someone other than its maker posts it.
effect.post: The journal is posted: its lines reach the balances and reports, and it can no longer be changed.
effect.reject: The journal goes back as rejected with your reason. Nothing is posted.
effect.cancel: The journal is cancelled and kept in the history. Nothing is posted.

done.approve: {{ref}} approved. It is not posted yet.

blocked.own_journal: You prepared this journal: someone else approves and posts it.
blocked.period_closed: Its month is closed: the journal cannot be approved or posted unless the month is reopened.
blocked.permission_missing: Your role does not allow this step.
blocked.already_reversed: This journal already has a reversal.
blocked.reversal_not_reversible: A reversal is not reversed again: prepare a new journal instead.

create.title: New journal
create.intro: A manual journal of one legal entity. Debits must equal credits; someone else approves and posts it.
create.dateHint: In an open month, not in the future.
create.memoHint: What the journal records, in plain words (3 to 200 characters).
create.linesHint: Each line has an amount on one side only. Two to twenty lines.
create.policy: Journal policy version {{version}}: every manual journal is approved by someone other than its maker and posted by someone other than its maker. No amount threshold.
create.saved: {{ref}} saved as a draft. It is not posted.
create.submitted: {{ref}} submitted for approval. It is not posted.
create.notEditable: Only its maker edits a draft. Submitted, approved and closed journals are not edited.
create.notEditablePosted: A posted journal is never edited. Correct it with a reversal.

why.amount: An amount is not valid: up to two decimals.
why.lines: Fill in at least two lines with an account and an amount.
why.unbalanced: Debits and credits must be equal.
why.period: The date is not in an open month.

reverse.title: Reverse journal
reverse.intro: A posted journal is corrected by a reversal journal: every line on the other side, linked to the original. Someone else approves and posts it.
reverse.chooseTitle: Posted journals that can be reversed
reverse.none: No posted journal can be reversed
reverse.previewIntro: The reversal will have these lines:
reverse.dateHint: In an open month, on or after the original journal.
reverse.effect: The reversal waits for approval by someone else. The original stays posted and unchanged; it reads reversed once the reversal is posted.
reverse.requested: Reversal {{ref}} of {{original}} requested. It waits for approval.

blocked.reversed: This journal already has a reversal.
blocked.reversal: A reversal is not reversed again.
blocked.notPosted: Only a posted journal is reversed. Cancel or reject one that is not posted.
blocked.permission: Your role does not prepare journals.

tie.bs: Assets equal liabilities plus equity plus the current result.
tie.bsFail: The balance sheet does not balance.
tie.pl: The current result equals the profit and loss for the same months.
tie.plFail: The current result differs from the profit and loss (no year-end close in the prototype).

tb.title: Trial balance
tb.intro: Every account with posted lines and its balance on the debit or credit side.

pl.title: Profit and loss
pl.intro: Income and expenses posted in the fiscal year up to the chosen month.
pl.policy: No revenue is recognised in the prototype. Bookings and instalments are not revenue; an accounting adviser decides the policy.
pl.toBalanceSheet: Open the balance sheet for the same month

bs.title: Balance sheet
bs.intro: Assets, liabilities and equity at the end of the chosen month, from posted journals.
bs.noYearEnd: There is no year-end close in the prototype: the current result is not moved to retained earnings.

periods.title: Accounting periods
periods.intro: Months of the books of one legal entity. A closed month refuses every posting.

period_ended.blocking: The month has not ended yet.

journals_unposted.passed: No journal dated in the month is waiting.
journals_unposted.blocking: {{count}} journal(s) dated in the month are not posted, rejected or cancelled yet.

blocked.own_request: You asked to reopen it: someone else decides.
blocked.blocking_checks: It cannot close until every check passes.

effect.close: No journal dated in this month can be posted after it is closed.
effect.reopen-request: Someone with the right to close months decides. The month stays closed until then.
effect.reopen-approve: Journals dated in this month can be posted again until it is closed again.

policy.approval: Every manual journal and every reversal needs approval.
policy.approver: The approver is someone other than the person who prepared it.
policy.poster: The person who posts it is someone other than the person who prepared it.
policy.thresholds: No amount threshold is set (no default amounts).

rules.title: Posting rules
rules.intro: Which accounts a business event would post to, versioned by date. Proposals only.
rules.blocked: No journal is created from these rules. An accounting adviser must decide revenue recognition (E-15), the chart (E-16) and automatic posting (E-17) first, and their source screens do not exist yet.
rules.events_one: {{count}} source event is waiting to be proposed.
rules.events_other: {{count}} source events are waiting to be proposed.

event.buyer_payment_confirmed: Buyer payment confirmed by a statement line
event.supplier_payment_settled: Supplier payment settled on a statement line

rules.previewOnly: Preview only — nothing is stored or posted.
rules.effectiveHint: Versions apply by date; a new version does not change journals already posted.
rules.draftEffect: The version is stored as proposed. It is not applied.
rules.applyBlocked: Blocked until an accounting adviser decides {{decisions}}. No journal is created from this rule.

bank.title: Bank import
bank.intro: Import a sample bank statement for one of the entity's verified accounts: preview, check every row, find duplicates, then have someone else approve it.
bank.boundary: An approved import adds unmatched statement lines. They are not receipts, settle nothing and post nothing. Matching comes with the collections and payables slices.
bank.noImport: Your role reads imports; importing and approving need the bank reconcile permission.
bank.newIntro: Choose the account and the file. Nothing is stored until the preview is approved by someone else.
bank.accountHint: Only a verified account of this entity is accepted.
bank.pasteHint: Header row, then: transaction id, value date (YYYY-MM-DD), amount (negative for money out), narration, reference, counterparty.
bank.previewed: Preview {{ref}} ready. Nothing is imported yet.
bank.nothingNew: There is no new row to import.
bank.committedNote_one: {{count}} new line was imported as an unmatched statement line.
bank.committedNote_other: {{count}} new lines were imported as unmatched statement lines.

blocked.own_import: You prepared this import: someone else approves it.
blocked.permission_missing: Approving needs the bank reconcile permission.

effect.submit: Someone else with the bank reconcile permission approves it.
effect.approve: The new rows are added as unmatched statement lines (rows already imported are skipped). Nothing is received, settled or posted.

bank.linesIntro: Lines from approved imports. None is matched to a payment, a receipt or a journal.

history.account_seeded: Set up with the illustrative chart

problems.invalidState: This step does not apply in the record's current state. Nothing was changed.
problems.makerChecker: Someone other than the person who prepared it must do this. Nothing was changed.
problems.notMaker: Only the person who prepared it can do this. Nothing was changed.
problems.periodClosed: The month is closed. Nothing was posted.
problems.periodClosedDetail: {{period}} is closed: choose a date in an open month.
problems.journalPosted: A posted journal is never changed. Correct it with a reversal.
problems.notPosted: Only a posted journal can be reversed.
problems.alreadyReversed: This journal already has a reversal.
problems.reversalNotReversible: A reversal is not reversed again.
problems.closeBlocked: The month cannot close yet: a check is not passed.
problems.decisionPending: This rule is a proposal: it is not applied until an accounting adviser decides.
problems.keyReused: This request was already used for something else. Nothing was changed; try again.
problems.training: Practice mode does not change the ledger.
problems.nothingNew: There is no new row to import.
problems.dateFuture: The date cannot be in the future.
problems.dateBeforeBooks: The date is before the books began.
problems.reasonShort: Give a reason of at least {{min}} characters.
problems.linesFew: A journal needs at least two lines.
problems.linesMany: A journal has at most {{max}} lines.
problems.accountUnavailable: Choose an active account of this legal entity.
problems.accountLockedCash: Cash at bank changes only from confirmed payments or settlement confirmations (E-17).
problems.accountLockedRevenue: No revenue is recognised until the policy is set (E-15).
problems.amountInvalid: Enter an amount with at most two decimals.
problems.amountOneSide: Enter an amount on one side only: debit or credit.
problems.costCentreUnavailable: Choose a cost centre of this legal entity.
problems.unbalanced: Debits ({{debit}}) and credits ({{credit}}) must be equal.
problems.reverseBefore: The reversal cannot be dated before the original journal.
problems.periodUnknown: Choose a month of the books.
problems.codeTaken: This code is already in the chart.
problems.versionDateTaken: A version already starts on this date.
problems.bankAccountUnavailable: Choose one of this entity's verified bank accounts.
problems.statementAccountMismatch: The file names another account than the one chosen. Nothing was imported.
problems.fileEmpty: Choose a sample or paste a statement.
problems.fileLarge: The file is too large for the prototype (100 KB).
problems.fileNoRows: The file has no statement rows.
